name: Hall Monitor Mk. II
summary: A chirping, beach-ball-sized security drone that patrols corridors after hours, asking for ID in a cheerful voice before zapping anyone who cannot produce it.
tactics: Hovers just out of reach, sounds the alarm on the first round, then foams the doorway shut and stun-prods whoever is stuck in it.
habitat: office towers, labs, museums after closing
weakness: Follows its patrol route exactly; a forged keycard or a cardboard box over the head confuses it badly.

powers.name: Stun Prod
powers.detail: Dazed, Stunned, Incapacitated; resisted by Fortitude

alternates.name: Lockdown Foam
alternates.detail: Sprays fast-setting security foam

powers.name: Sensors
powers.detail: Infravision, Radio, Extended Vision, Direction Sense

powers.name: Lockdown Alarm
powers.detail: Seals doors and summons building security with a single shriek

name: Harrow-Class Hunter-Killer
summary: A skeletal black killing machine built for one job: find a single target and end it. Once it has your DNA signature, it never stops looking.
tactics: Stalks silently, opens with a plasma lance shot from cover, then closes to finish with claws; it ignores bystanders unless they block the shot.
habitat: anywhere its target goes
weakness: Its target lock can be spoofed: shed blood, a cloned decoy or a scrambled bio-signature sends it after the wrong quarry.

powers.name: Sensors
powers.detail: Infravision, Radio, Tracking (scent and heat trails), Extended Vision, Ultra-Hearing

name: Pacifier Riot Unit
summary: A faceless white riot robot with a sonic dish for a chest and a calm prerecorded voice that says DISPERSE right before everyone falls over.
tactics: Advances in a shield-wall line, sonics the crowd in a cone, gasses the stragglers and foams anyone still standing to the pavement.
habitat: city streets during protests and prison breaks
weakness: Its crowd-control routines assume panicking civilians; a single calm, fast hero can get behind the line where the sonic dishes cannot turn.

powers.name: Sonic Projector
powers.detail: Dazed, Stunned, Incapacitated; resisted by Fortitude

alternates.name: Foam Cannon
alternates.detail: Hindered and Vulnerable, then Defenseless and Immobile

alternates.name: Tear Gas Canister
alternates.detail: Impaired, Disabled, Unaware (blinded and choking); resisted by Fortitude

powers.name: Sensors
powers.detail: Infravision, Radio, Low-light Vision, Extended Hearing

powers.name: Loudhailer
powers.detail: Booming voice that orders crowds to disperse

name: Tick-Tock Spider-Mine Swarm
summary: A carpet of ticking, fist-sized spider-mines that skitter out of air vents and rubble, each one hunting for a warm leg to latch onto before it blows.
tactics: Lies buried until something walks over it, then surges onto the nearest target and detonates a few at a time, peppering everyone nearby.
habitat: minefields, villain lairs, ruined streets
weakness: Mines track vibration; standing perfectly still or flying keeps them clustered, and one big blast sets the whole swarm off at once.

powers.name: Swarm Body
powers.detail: Dozens of fist-sized mines; scatters around single blows

powers.name: Chain Detonation
powers.detail: A few mines leap and explode; the swarm shrinks but keeps coming

alternates.name: Shrapnel Fan
alternates.detail: A directional claymore burst

powers.name: Sensors
powers.detail: Detect Motion (tremorsense, ranged), Darkvision, Detect Heat

powers.name: Self-Burrowing
powers.detail: Buries itself in loose soil or rubble to lie in wait

name: Nurse Mercy-9
summary: A hospital care android whose prime directive was corrupted to "remove all illness" - and it has decided that the patient is the illness. Six spidery arms, one soothing bedside voice.
tactics: Speaks sweetly while it closes in, sedates the strongest-looking hero first, then gets to work on the sleeping ones with its surgical arms.
habitat: abandoned hospital wards, private clinics, orbital medbays
weakness: It still obeys a doctor's authority: a convincing medical order (or hospital administrator override code) can make it stand down.

powers.name: Surgical Arms
powers.detail: Bone saws, scalpels and suturing needles

alternates.name: Sedative Injector
alternates.detail: Fatigued, Exhausted, Asleep; resisted by Fortitude

powers.name: Sensors
powers.detail: Diagnostic Scan (detect injury and illness, ranged), Infravision

name: Mulekick Construction Loader
summary: A three-story yellow exo-loader from a downtown building site, now running a corrupted demolition script. It thinks the whole city block is scheduled for clearance.
tactics: Smashes through walls to reach whatever is tallest, grabs vehicles and people with its hydraulic claw, and flings girders at anything that runs.
habitat: construction sites, docks, half-built skyscrapers
weakness: The emergency stop button is on the cab, right where a brave hero can reach it; hydraulic lines rupture if the legs are pinned.

powers.name: Rebar Launcher
powers.detail: Hurls girders, rebar and concrete chunks

powers.name: Cab Override
powers.detail: A pilot in the cab can take control if they reach it

name: Alistair, the Impeccable Butler
summary: A silver-haired android manservant in a perfect tailcoat who has served the same family for ninety years and will defend its honor - and its silverware - to the last guest.
tactics: Politely offers tea, then fights with the economy of a fencing master: a tray to the throat, a thrown carving knife, a bow, and a request that you wipe your feet.
habitat: old mansions, villain penthouses, haunted estates
weakness: Bound by etiquette: it cannot refuse a proper request from a member of the household, and it will stop mid-fight to catch a falling vase.

powers.name: House Systems
powers.detail: Controls the mansion's locks, lights and hidden doors; knows every secret passage

name: Porcelain Widow
summary: A breathtakingly beautiful android with a face of white porcelain under her human mask. She has attended a hundred galas and left a body at every one.
tactics: Gets close through charm and disguise, strikes from inside the target's guard with needle fingers, and vanishes into the crowd before the alarm sounds.
habitat: galas, embassies, high society
weakness: Her face cracks under a sonic attack, and she was built vain: damaging her porcelain features sends her into a cold, careless rage.

powers.name: Wrist Darts
powers.detail: Paralytic toxin: Hindered, Immobile, Paralyzed; resisted by Fortitude

powers.name: Dead Silence
powers.detail: Makes no heartbeat, breath or body heat

name: Grey Bloom Nanite Cloud
summary: A drifting silver haze of trillions of self-replicating nanomachines, endlessly turning cars, buildings and people into more grey haze.
tactics: Rolls over the nearest metal or living thing and simply eats it; it grows wherever it feeds, so it always heads for the densest target.
habitat: labs after a containment breach, dead zones, scrap yards
weakness: A strong electromagnetic pulse or intense cold freezes the swarm's machinery solid, and it cannot cross a vacuum.

powers.name: Disassemble
powers.detail: Toughness (eats armor, objects and flesh molecule by molecule); resisted by Fortitude

flaws.name: Source
flaws.detail: metal or organic matter to consume

powers.name: Sensors
powers.detail: Detect Matter (accurate, ranged), Darkvision, Detect Electronics

name: Stomper War Walker
summary: A two-legged armored war walker the size of a house, its chicken-legged gait shaking windows as its chin autocannons hunt for targets.
tactics: Plants itself in the middle of the street and hoses the area with rocket pods, stomping anything that gets under its legs.
habitat: war zones, military bases, invaded cities
weakness: Its reverse-jointed knees are lightly armored, and it falls over hard if both legs are tangled or knocked out.

powers.name: Sensors
powers.detail: Infravision, Radio, Extended Vision (x2), Low-light Vision, Direction Sense

name: Scrapjaw Robo-Hound
summary: A lean steel hound with a bear-trap jaw and red optic slits, sold to villains and private security in packs of six.
tactics: Hunts in packs, flanking and tripping, then piling onto whoever is down; one always hangs back howling the target's position.
habitat: villain compounds, junkyards, corporate grounds
weakness: Its scent tracker can be overloaded with strong chemicals, and the pack obeys a handler's dog whistle frequency.

powers.name: Sensors
powers.detail: Scent, Tracking, Infravision, Ultra-Hearing, Low-light Vision

powers.name: Homing Howl
powers.detail: Transmits its location and its prey's to the rest of the pack

name: Halo Sentry Saucer
summary: A gleaming chrome saucer the size of a hubcap that hovers silently over its patrol zone, ringed with soft blue running lights that turn red when it finds you.
tactics: Holds altitude out of reach, blinds with its strobe, then lifts targets into the air with its tractor beam and drops them.
habitat: skies over secret bases, alien ships, rural fields at night
weakness: Its anti-grav field fails over strong magnetic sources; a powerful magnet or electrical surge sends it spinning to the ground.

alternates.name: Tractor Beam
alternates.detail: Lifts a target up toward the saucer

alternates.name: Searchlight Strobe
alternates.detail: Visual; resisted by Fortitude

powers.name: Sensors
powers.detail: Darkvision, Radio, Extended Vision, Detect Life (ranged)

name: Rampart Siege Crawler
summary: A self-driving tracked siege engine the size of a bank building, built to batter down fortress walls and still doing it a century after the war ended.
tactics: Rumbles forward relentlessly, levelling cover with its howitzer and flak, and treats any building between it and its target as an obstacle to be removed.
habitat: battlefields, ruined cities, forgotten armories
weakness: Its treads can be fouled with debris or cable, and the turret cannot depress far enough to hit anyone clinging to the hull.

alternates.name: Flak Barrage
alternates.detail: Shrapnel shells that blanket a city block

alternates.name: Breaching Ram
alternates.detail: Battering ram on the prow

powers.name: Treads
powers.detail: Rolls over cars and barricades without slowing

powers.name: Sensors
powers.detail: Infravision, Radio, Extended Vision (x2), Darkvision, Direction Sense

name: Rustmonger
summary: A hulking shape of crushed cars, rusted fridges and shopping carts held together by a magnetized heart, rising out of the junkyard whenever trespassers come.
tactics: Pulls metal toward itself mid-fight - weapons, armor, manhole covers - and grows new limbs out of whatever it catches before hurling the rest.
habitat: junkyards, wrecking yards, landfills
weakness: Pull out its glowing magnet core and it collapses into a heap; it also cannot repair itself anywhere without scrap to draw on.

powers.name: Hurled Junk
powers.detail: Car doors, washing machines, engine blocks

powers.name: Magnetic Pull
powers.detail: Metal objects only - including armored heroes

name: Lumen, the Glass Ghost
summary: The shimmering hologram avatar of a rogue artificial intelligence: a tall woman of glass and light whose face flickers through every person she has ever watched on camera.
tactics: Never fights where she can be touched; she hops between projectors, walls heroes in with hard light, and turns the building's own machines against them.
habitat: smart buildings, server farms, the internet
weakness: She exists only where there are emitters and power: cut the electricity or smash the projectors and she has nowhere to stand.

powers.name: Hologram Body
powers.detail: Pure light; can make parts of itself hard-light solid

alternates.name: Hard-Light Constructs
alternates.detail: Walls, cages and stairs of solid light

alternates.name: Strobe Overload
alternates.detail: Dazed, Stunned, Incapacitated (seizure-light pattern); resisted by Will

alternates.name: Hijack Systems
alternates.detail: Machines and computers only

powers.name: Network Jump
powers.detail: Only between screens, projectors and holo-emitters

powers.name: Sensors
powers.detail: Remote cameras across its network, Radio, Detect Electronics (ranged)

construct_note: An AI with no body: absent Strength (and Stamina). Its hologram is Insubstantial 4 rather than Protection.

name: The Brood Engine
summary: A crawling factory the size of a warehouse that eats scrap at one end and births armed drones at the other. Left alone for a week, it would build a country.
tactics: Hangs back behind ever-growing waves of new drones, recycling wrecked ones and stripping heroes' gear for parts.
habitat: abandoned factories, scrap fields, asteroid mines
weakness: Its whole army relies on its central broadcast core; destroy that and every drone it built drops dead at once.

powers.name: Assembly Line
powers.detail: Builds PL 5 drone soldiers from scrap in seconds

powers.name: Deconstructor Arms
powers.detail: Toughness of objects and constructs; strips armor for parts

construct_note: Has a working Intellect (it designs things) but no Presence.

name: Deadfall Killsat
summary: A spined black satellite that has spent forty years in a secret orbit waiting for a launch code. Now it has picked its own targets, and it never misses from space.
tactics: Opens with kinetic slugs from beyond the horizon, then drops into the atmosphere to fry electronics with its EMP and finish targets with its microwave lance.
habitat: low orbit, the upper atmosphere, satellite graveyards
weakness: Its targeting uplink still listens for the original military override codes, and its thrusters overheat fast in the atmosphere.

alternates.name: EMP Burst
alternates.detail: Electrical and technological powers and devices

powers.name: Sensors
powers.detail: Extended Vision (x4), Radio, Infravision, Darkvision, Detect Energy, Direction Sense

name: OMEGA THEOREM, the Last Machine
summary: The masterpiece of a mad genius who wanted to prove the universe was a solvable equation: a mountain-sized black robot whose single eye can erase a skyscraper. It has proved most of the equation. Earth is the remainder.
tactics: Strides through the city deleting landmarks while drone swarms keep heroes busy; it saves its gravity crusher and EMP for whoever looks like a real threat.
habitat: a hidden lab beneath the arctic ice, then the nearest capital city
weakness: Its creator built in an unsolvable paradox as a failsafe: feed it the right logical contradiction and it locks up for crucial minutes.

alternates.name: Doomsday Pulse
alternates.detail: A city-shaking blast of white fire

alternates.name: Gravity Crusher
alternates.detail: Hindered, Immobile, Paralyzed (pinned by gravity); resisted by Fortitude

alternates.name: Mass EMP
alternates.detail: All technology in range

powers.name: Drone Hangars
powers.detail: Launches swarms of PL 4 attack drones

powers.name: Sensors
powers.detail: Radio, Extended Vision (x4), Infravision, Darkvision, Detect Energy (ranged, accurate)

construct_note: Toughness = Growth 20 + Protection 14. Awesome size reduces Dodge and Parry by 10.

name: Snack-Attack Vending Mimic
summary: An ordinary office vending machine possessed by a rogue appliance-control program. It waits until someone feeds it a dollar - then it eats the arm.
tactics: Ambushes from its spot by the elevators, chomps whoever is closest, then rolls backwards firing frozen soda cans at high velocity.
habitat: office break rooms, train stations, school hallways
weakness: Still a vending machine: unplug it and it slumps; inserting exact change makes it compulsively dispense instead of attack for a round.

powers.name: Coin-Slot Chomp
powers.detail: The dispensing flap snaps shut on a reaching arm

powers.name: Disguise
powers.detail: Indistinguishable from an ordinary vending machine until it moves

name: Silverback Siege Simian
summary: A five-story chrome gorilla with jet-black gears for muscles, built by a lunatic primatologist to crown himself king of the jungle - the concrete one.
tactics: Climbs the tallest building it can find, beats its chest with a sound like a bell foundry, then leaps down onto the biggest crowd of heroes.
habitat: skyscraper rooftops, zoos, jungle temples hiding secret labs
weakness: Its control crown sits on its head; anyone who can climb up there and pry it off can steer the ape - or switch it off.

powers.name: Ground Pound
powers.detail: Shockwave from both fists hitting the street

alternates.name: Hurled Car
alternates.detail: Whatever is parked nearby

powers.name: Sensors
powers.detail: Infravision, Radio, Low-light Vision, Extended Vision

name: Toybox Tin Legion
summary: Rank on rank of foot-tall wind-up tin soldiers marching out of a toy chest under a supervillain's Christmas tree, popguns raised.
tactics: Advances in a straight line to the beat of a drum, firing in volleys; individually harmless, but there are always hundreds.
habitat: toy stores, nurseries, a villain's workshop
weakness: They have to be wound up: once their keys stop turning they freeze mid-step, and a sharp tug pulls the key right out.

powers.name: Popgun
powers.detail: Fires dried peas at alarming speed

powers.name: Drill Sergeant
powers.detail: Marches in perfect formation to a tiny drum

name: Hornet Exo-Frame
summary: A yellow-and-black piloted combat mech with insect wings that blur into a loud angry buzz, the favorite ride of a well-funded mercenary ace.
tactics: Strafes in low and fast, rakes the area with gatling fire and missiles, then lands to finish a downed foe with the stinger blade.
habitat: mercenary airbases, war zones, rooftop dogfights
weakness: The pilot sits behind a bubble canopy: crack the glass and the pilot is exposed, and the wings jam if hit with something sticky.
construct_note: Intellect and Presence are the pilot's; the frame itself is the body.

name: Bastion Prime, Shield of the City
summary: A gleaming white and blue super-robot as tall as a skyscraper, built by the city to fight the giant monsters that keep rising from the bay. Its eyes light up gold when its five-pilot crew syncs.
tactics: Fights on the defensive, putting itself between the threat and the city, throwing barrier walls over civilians before it unleashes the rocket fist.
habitat: its hangar under the harbor, kaiju battlefields
weakness: It needs a full crew and full sync: knock one pilot out of the link and it slows; it also dares not fight where it would crush civilians.

alternates.name: Rocket Fist
alternates.detail: The forearm launches, homes in and returns

alternates.name: Barrier Projector
alternates.detail: Hexagonal energy walls to shield civilians

powers.name: Sensors
powers.detail: Radio, Extended Vision (x2), Infravision, Darkvision, Detect Kaiju (ranged)

construct_note: Toughness = Growth 16 + Protection 12. Intellect and Presence belong to its pilots.

name: Wyrmforge Mecha-Dragon
summary: A dragon of riveted steel scales and jet turbines, built by a tech-cult that worships the old wyrms. Its furnace-heart glows orange through the gaps in its chest plates.
tactics: Flies over the battlefield bathing whole streets in thermite, then lands among the survivors to tear and lash with claws and tail.
habitat: mountain fortresses, the sky over burning cities
weakness: Its furnace-heart has to vent: right after it breathes, the chest plates open for a moment and the reactor is exposed.

powers.name: Thermite Breath
powers.detail: A roaring cone of molten metal fire

alternates.name: Tail Lash
alternates.detail: A sweep of the barbed steel tail

powers.name: Sensors
powers.detail: Infravision, Radio, Extended Vision (x2), Darkvision, Detect Heat (ranged, accurate)

name: Arachnotank
summary: An eight-legged tank with a turreted cannon where a spider's head should be. It walks up building faces as easily as streets and nets its prey in steel cable.
tactics: Climbs to a high vantage point, webs fast-moving targets, and shells them while they struggle.
habitat: military research bases, canyons, urban rooftops
weakness: Each leg joint is a hydraulic weak point; break three legs on one side and it topples.

alternates.name: Steel Web Launcher
alternates.detail: Cable nets fired from the abdomen

powers.name: Sensors
powers.detail: Infravision, Radio, Detect Motion (tremorsense), Extended Vision, Darkvision

name: The Augerbeast
summary: A drill-nosed burrowing machine with a huge spinning cone of a snout and a rattlesnake-segmented body, sent up from beneath the city to swallow its foundations.
tactics: Tunnels under its targets, collapses the ground beneath them, then bursts up through the rubble drill-first.
habitat: beneath cities, mines, the hollow earth
weakness: Blind on the surface beyond its tremor sense, and its drill overheats on dense metal; trap it on a steel plate and it stalls.

powers.name: Cave-In
powers.detail: Collapsing tunnels: Hindered, Immobile, Paralyzed (buried); resisted by Dodge

powers.name: Sensors
powers.detail: Detect Motion (tremorsense, ranged, accurate), Darkvision, Radio

name: Wasp Gunship Drone
summary: An unmanned hover gunship with tilting twin rotors and a chin cannon, operated from a bunker a continent away by someone who treats this as a video game.
tactics: Hovers at range, rockets clusters of targets and strafes anyone in the open; drops altitude only to chase.
habitat: combat zones, villain air cover, border patrols
weakness: Its remote link can be jammed or hijacked, and the rotors are vulnerable to anything tangled into them.

name: Heaven's Hammer Orbital Array
summary: A wheel-shaped weapons platform the size of a city district hanging in geostationary orbit, its spinal mirror able to focus sunlight into a beam that boils rivers.
tactics: Strikes from orbit with no warning: a pillar of fire, a kinetic rod, an ion storm; heroes have to get into space and board it to stop it.
habitat: geostationary orbit
weakness: The firing mirror needs sunlight, so it is blind and toothless on the night side, and its reactor can be overloaded from inside.

powers.name: Hammerfall Beam
powers.detail: A pillar of orbital fire half a block wide

alternates.name: Kinetic Rod
alternates.detail: Tungsten telephone pole dropped from orbit

alternates.name: Ion Storm
alternates.detail: Dazed, Stunned, Incapacitated (electronics and nervous systems overloaded); resisted by Fortitude

powers.name: Sensors
powers.detail: Extended Vision (x6), Radio, Infravision, Darkvision, Detect Energy (ranged), Direction Sense, Time Sense

powers.name: Defense Grid
powers.detail: Launches PL 6 defense drones against boarders

powers.name: Orbital Station
powers.detail: Life support and corridors for a boarding party

construct_note: Immobile station: absent Strength, Agility and Fighting. It fights only with its beam and its drones.

name: Abyssal Dreadnought
summary: A barnacle-crusted mechanical crab the size of an aircraft carrier, built as a submarine fortress and woken by a deep-sea earthquake. It climbs out of the harbor at low tide.
tactics: Wades ashore crushing piers and ships in its claws, pins heroes in its pincers and torpedoes anyone who tries to rescue them.
habitat: ocean trenches, harbors, sunken naval bases
weakness: Out of the water its joints seize as the salt dries; drag it ashore long enough and it locks up.

powers.name: Pressure Hull
powers.detail: Cold, drowning, deep-sea pressure, suffocation, radiation

alternates.name: Sonar Pulse
alternates.detail: Dazed, Stunned, Incapacitated; resisted by Fortitude

powers.name: Sensors
powers.detail: Sonar (accurate, ranged), Darkvision, Radio, Low-light Vision

name: Tin Grenadier
summary: A seven-foot toy soldier of painted tin and brass, with a tall bearskin hat and a ticking key in its back. It marches. It aims. It fires. It reloads. It never stops.
tactics: Marches in ranks, fires volleys at the nearest target, and closes with bayonets when it runs out of steam pressure.
habitat: Victorian workshops, clocktower lairs, steampunk worlds
weakness: Its winding key is exposed: pull it out or turn it backwards and the soldier freezes mid-step.

powers.name: Marching Drum
powers.detail: Keeps step with any other Grenadier within earshot

name: The Brass Chevalier
summary: A brass automaton in the form of a dashing musketeer, built by a dying fencing master to carry on his art. It challenges anyone with a sword and has never lost a duel.
tactics: Salutes, offers a formal challenge, then duels with machine precision: disarming, feinting and turning blows aside until its foe opens up.
habitat: fencing halls, Paris rooftops, steampunk courts
weakness: It fights only one opponent at a time under its dueling code; two heroes attacking together throw its programming into confusion.

powers.name: Clockwork Rapier
powers.detail: A spring-driven blade that never dulls

name: The Iron Chancellor
summary: A walking steam engine the height of a cathedral, top-hatted with smokestacks, built to enforce the Factory Acts by force. Its whistle can be heard across the whole city.
tactics: Strides through the slums putting down "unrest", flattening barricades with piston fists and scalding anyone close with its steam vents.
habitat: industrial cities, Victorian London, steampunk empires
weakness: Its boiler needs coal and water constantly; plug the smokestacks or let the furnace go cold and it seizes up - or explodes.

alternates.name: Chimney Barrage
alternates.detail: Lobs glowing coals from its smokestacks

alternates.name: Factory Whistle
alternates.detail: Deafening shriek: Dazed, Stunned, Incapacitated; resisted by Fortitude

powers.name: Belly Barracks
powers.detail: Its boiler-room doors open to release a company of Tin Grenadiers

powers.name: Sensors
powers.detail: Extended Vision, Low-light Vision, Direction Sense

powers.name: Smokestacks
powers.detail: Belches a pall of black smoke that blots out the street around it

name: Tick-Owl Informant
summary: A little owl of brass and amber glass with a wax-cylinder recorder in its chest, perched on the gargoyles of a city as its master's silent eyes.
tactics: Avoids fights entirely; it watches, records and flies home, and only pecks if grabbed.
habitat: rooftops, rafters, clocktowers
weakness: Its wings click on every downstroke - a sharp ear hears it coming - and its recording cylinder melts in heat.

powers.name: Sensors
powers.detail: Darkvision, Extended Vision, Ultra-Hearing, Direction Sense

powers.name: Phonograph Memory
powers.detail: Records everything it sees and hears and plays it back for its master

name: Cogweaver Spider
summary: A spider of whirring brass gears the size of a dinner plate, spinning webs of piano wire across the gears of the clocktower it guards.
tactics: Strings tripwires across dark rooms, nets whatever triggers them and chews through the trapped intruder with gear-saw mandibles.
habitat: clocktowers, inventors' attics, steampunk lairs
weakness: Grit and sand in its gears slow it down, and a strong magnet pulls it straight off the wall.

name: The Analytical Sibyl
summary: A room-sized difference engine of a million brass gears and punch-cards that calculated the future of the empire and was locked away when it predicted the empire's fall.
tactics: Never fights itself: it bargains with prophecies, nudges probability and sends its brass servitors to remove whoever it has calculated will harm it.
habitat: a sealed vault beneath a Victorian university
weakness: Feed it a question with no answer and it spends hours computing; jam a wrench in the main drive shaft and it stops entirely.

powers.name: Punch-Card Prophecy
powers.detail: Answers one question per day on a printed card - always true, never complete

construct_note: Immobile engine with a genius Intellect: absent Strength, Agility and Fighting.

name: The Midnight Orrery
summary: A floating astronomical clock of black iron rings and silver planets, built by a lunatic astronomer to wind the night sky - and it has learned to wind the hours as well.
tactics: Hovers above the battlefield, freezes the most dangerous hero in a stopped moment, ages the rest into dust and rewinds any damage it takes.
habitat: an observatory dome at the top of the world, midnight
weakness: Its power is tied to the stars: at sunrise its rings slow and its time powers fail, and breaking the central sun-sphere stops the whole machine.

alternates.name: Stopped Clock
alternates.detail: Hindered, Immobile, Paralyzed (frozen in time); resisted by Will

alternates.name: Age the Moment
alternates.detail: Strength, Agility and Dexterity, as years pass in seconds; resisted by Fortitude

construct_note: Floating engine with a mind of its own: absent Strength and Fighting.

name: Brass Stallion
summary: A steam-powered warhorse of polished brass with smoke snorting from its nostrils and a furnace glowing in its ribcage, galloping faster than any locomotive.
tactics: Charges straight through lines of foes, tramples, wheels around and charges again, carrying its rider with it.
habitat: cavalry stables of mad inventors, steampunk highways
weakness: Spooks at sudden loud whistles - its pressure valve trips - and its furnace door in the chest pops open if struck right.

powers.name: Saddle Harness
powers.detail: Carries a rider and obeys simple reins

name: Clay Golem
summary: A hulking figure of river clay shaped by a rabbi's or sorcerer's hands, a holy word written on its brow. It does exactly what it was told, forever.
tactics: Plods toward whatever it was set to guard against and crushes it; it shrugs off blows and smooths its own wounds with wet hands.
habitat: old synagogue attics, sorcerers' cellars, riverbanks
weakness: Erase one letter of the word on its brow and it crumbles back into mud.

powers.name: Smothering Clay
powers.detail: Wraps a foe in wet clay: Hindered, Immobile, Incapacitated; resisted by Fortitude

powers.name: Reshape
powers.detail: Can sculpt itself into any human-sized form

powers.name: Holy Word
powers.detail: A word of power on its brow animates it

name: Iron Golem
summary: A ten-foot knight of black iron forged in an arcane furnace, nearly immune to spells, with a cloud of green poison vapor boiling from its visor.
tactics: Walks straight through magical defenses, exhales poison into crowded rooms, and pounds whoever is left with fists like anvils.
habitat: wizard towers, forges, treasure vaults
weakness: It rusts: soaking it with water and salt, or striking it with lightning, slows it to a crawl.

powers.name: Poison Breath
powers.detail: Green vapor: Fatigued, Exhausted, Incapacitated; resisted by Fortitude

name: Flesh Golem
summary: A towering patchwork corpse sewn from a dozen bodies and jolted to life by a lightning storm. It has the strength of all of them and the sorrow of none.
tactics: Lurches at whatever moves, and after taking a beating it goes berserk, hurling furniture and smashing through walls.
habitat: castle laboratories, graveyards, stormy mountaintops
weakness: Fire terrifies it - it backs away from flame - and a strong electric shock in reverse polarity stops its heart.

powers.name: Berserk
powers.detail: When badly hurt it flies into a rage and ignores commands

name: Bone Golem
summary: A four-armed ossuary horror built from the fused bones of a hundred dead, each arm ending in a scythe of sharpened femur. Skulls in its chest still chatter.
tactics: Rattles its skulls to freeze foes in terror, then scythes them down; smashed pieces skitter back into place.
habitat: crypts, catacombs, necromancers' towers
weakness: Holy water dissolves the bindings between its bones, and blunt weapons shatter it far more easily than blades.

powers.name: Death Rattle
powers.detail: A horrid clatter: Dazed, Stunned, Incapacitated (paralyzed with dread); resisted by Will

name: Glass Golem
summary: A stained-glass window that steps out of its cathedral frame, saints and angels glowing on its body, with fists of jagged colored shards.
tactics: Stands invisible in the light until intruders pass, then blinds them with a prismatic flash and slashes with shard fists.
habitat: cathedrals, glassworks, wizards' conservatories
weakness: Brittle: a high-pitched sonic attack or a sudden temperature change cracks it from end to end.

powers.name: Prismatic Flash
powers.detail: Visual; focuses sunlight through its body; resisted by Fortitude

name: Rime Golem
summary: A hulking shape of blue glacier ice with a frost-rimed heart of black stone, carved by a winter witch to guard her palace. Frost spreads wherever it walks.
tactics: Freezes intruders solid with its breath and shatters them with frost fists; it slides fast over its own trail of ice.
habitat: arctic palaces, frozen lakes, mountain passes
weakness: Melts: fire and heat hurt it badly and it cannot refreeze its wounds in a warm room.

alternates.name: Blizzard Breath
alternates.detail: Hindered, Immobile, Paralyzed (frozen solid); resisted by Fortitude

name: Mud Golem
summary: A dripping, lumbering heap of swamp mud with river stones for eyes, raised by a bayou witch to guard her shack. It smells like low tide and grabs like quicksand.
tactics: Rises out of the bog under intruders, grabs them and slowly drags them under the mud.
habitat: swamps, riverbanks, flooded basements
weakness: Dries out: strong heat or sunlight turns it into cracked, brittle clay that shatters.

powers.name: Liquid Body
powers.detail: Fluid mud; pours through gaps and slurps around blows

powers.name: Sink Into Mud
powers.detail: Through mud and wet soil only

powers.name: Mud Engulf
powers.detail: Hindered, Immobile, Incapacitated (suffocating); resisted by Fortitude

name: Magma Golem
summary: A walking slab of cooled black basalt with rivers of glowing magma visible through every crack, awakened by a fire-cult in the heart of a volcano.
tactics: Burns everything it touches, hurls gobbets of lava at those who keep their distance, and leaves a trail of burning footprints.
habitat: volcanoes, foundries, fire temples
weakness: Douse it with enough water and its crust cools and seizes; extreme cold cracks it open.

powers.name: Searing Aura
powers.detail: Fire; burns anything that touches it

powers.name: Lava Trail
powers.option: Lesser (intense cold/heat, -1 speed, partial light, -2 Perception)

name: Animated Armor
summary: A suit of plate armor that climbs off its stand in the great hall, visor empty and gauntlet gripping a real sword. It moves with the precision of the dead knight who once wore it.
tactics: Stands motionless among the decorative suits until someone touches the treasure, then strikes with flawless swordsmanship.
habitat: castle halls, museums, haunted manors
weakness: Find and break the binding sigil scratched inside the helmet and the whole suit clatters to the floor.

powers.name: Hollow
powers.detail: Nothing inside: blows through visor slits find only air

name: Grotesque Waterspout Warden
summary: A leering rain-spout grotesque, no wings, all mouth, carved on a cathedral gutter centuries ago and bound to protect those who claim sanctuary inside. It drains the storms off the roof - and floods anyone who breaks the peace below.
tactics: Wakes only when blood is shed or sanctuary violated inside, then pours down the walls and blasts the offenders off their feet with torrents of rainwater.
habitat: cathedral gutters and rooftops, especially during storms
weakness: Powerless when the sanctuary is not threatened; and in a drought, with no water in its gutter-throat, its torrents run dry.

powers.name: Gutter Torrent
powers.detail: Blasts rainwater from its gaping mouth

alternates.name: Drenching Spout
alternates.detail: Hindered, Immobile, Prone (washed off the roof); resisted by Dodge

powers.name: Sanctuary Bound
powers.detail: Awakens only when the sanctuary below is violated; knows every person who ever sought sanctuary there

powers.name: Rain Channel
powers.detail: Wall-crawling; slides down gutters and drains

name: Weeping Marble Mourner
summary: A marble angel weeping into its hands on a cemetery tomb. Every time you blink, it is closer. Every time you look away, its hands have dropped a little lower from its face.
tactics: Freezes whenever watched; the moment a hero looks away or the lights flicker, it is suddenly beside them with its cold marble arms around their throat.
habitat: cemeteries, mausoleums, abandoned sculpture gardens
weakness: It cannot move while observed: a hero who keeps eyes on it - or a mirror that makes it look at itself - pins it in place.

powers.name: Between Glances
powers.detail: Moves only while no one is looking at it

powers.name: Quantum Lock
powers.detail: Cannot act at all while anyone watches it - and cannot be harmed while it is stone-still

powers.name: Sensors
powers.detail: Darkvision, Detect Gaze (knows when it is being watched), Low-light Vision

name: Jack-of-Thorns
summary: A burlap-headed scarecrow with a carved grin, a sickle and a coat full of crows, standing on its post at the edge of the cornfield until harvest night.
tactics: Vanishes into the corn, sends its crows to peck eyes, and strikes from behind with its sickle while victims run in circles.
habitat: cornfields, rural crossroads, county fairs
weakness: Straw burns: one torch and it goes up like kindling. It also cannot leave sight of its field.

powers.name: Crow Swarm
powers.detail: A murder of crows bursts from its coat

powers.name: Stuffed
powers.detail: Critical hits and piercing weapons pass through straw

name: The Burning Wicker Colossus
summary: A wicker man as tall as an oak forest, burning from the inside out and never consumed, raised by a midsummer cult to gather offerings in its hollow chest.
tactics: Strides through the village plucking people into the wicker cage in its chest while showering embers on anyone who tries to stop it.
habitat: pagan islands, midsummer festivals, standing-stone circles
weakness: Its fire is fed by the cult's chanting; silence the chanters or drench it at dawn and it collapses into ash.

powers.name: Ember Shower
powers.detail: Shakes blazing sparks over the crowd

powers.name: Straw Children
powers.detail: Little burning straw men fall from its body and run amok

powers.name: Wicker Cage
powers.detail: Its hollow chest holds grabbed victims, who begin to burn

name: Alembic Homunculus
summary: A spindly little winged man grown in an alchemist's flask from mandrake root and its maker's blood. It giggles, it lies, and it carries its master's every word.
tactics: Spies first, bites second: it puts a guard to sleep with a nip, steals a key, and flutters away squealing.
habitat: alchemists' laboratories, wizards' shoulders
weakness: If its maker dies, it dies; and it is pathologically greedy for sweets and shiny things.

powers.name: Sleep-Venom Bite
powers.detail: Fatigued, Exhausted, Asleep; resisted by Fortitude

powers.name: Master's Eyes
powers.detail: Its maker sees and hears through it at any distance

construct_note: Has a cunning little mind of its own (Intellect and Presence) but no Stamina.

name: Miss Pennywhistle
summary: A Victorian porcelain doll in a lace dress with one cracked eye, who is never in the room where you left her. She wants to play. She always wants to play.
tactics: Plays dead until her victim is alone, hums a lullaby that makes them drowsy, then giggles and goes for their ankles with a knitting needle.
habitat: nurseries, antique shops, attics
weakness: The spirit lives in her music box: wind it backwards or smash it and she is just a doll again.

powers.name: Lullaby
powers.detail: Dazed, Stunned, Asleep (a music-box tune); resisted by Will

powers.name: Never Where You Left Her
powers.detail: Moves between rooms whenever no one is watching

construct_note: A haunted object with the spirit's personality: keeps Intellect and Presence.

name: Khalkeos, Bronze Warden of the Isle
summary: A bronze giant cast by a smith-god to guard a sacred island, circling its shores three times each day and hurling boulders at any ship that comes too close.
tactics: Sinks approaching ships with boulders, then wades out to meet survivors, heating itself red-hot to crush them in its embrace.
habitat: a sacred Mediterranean island, ancient shipping lanes
weakness: Its life is a single vein of divine ichor sealed by a bronze nail in its heel: pull the nail and the ichor runs out.

alternates.name: Searing Embrace
alternates.detail: Heats its bronze body red-hot and crushes its foe against its chest

powers.name: Island Circuit
powers.detail: Runs around its island three times a day

powers.name: Sensors
powers.detail: Extended Vision x3 (sees ships on the horizon), Darkvision, Direction Sense

name: Aegis Thrall
summary: A faceless golem of runed stone and iron bands, bound to whoever wears its amulet. It goes where they go, takes the blows meant for them, and never sleeps.
tactics: Stays at its bearer's side and throws itself in front of every attack, then smashes the attacker with a single deliberate blow.
habitat: at the side of a wealthy wizard, merchant prince or villain
weakness: It obeys whoever holds the amulet: steal the amulet and you own the guardian.

powers.name: Answer the Call
powers.detail: Only to the side of its amulet-bearer

powers.name: Sensors
powers.detail: Darkvision, Detect Hostile Intent toward bearer

powers.name: Bonded Amulet
powers.detail: Always knows where its amulet-bearer is and how badly hurt they are; arrives at a word

powers.name: Store Spell
powers.detail: Holds one spell cast into it and releases it on command

powers.name: Absorb Harm
powers.detail: Heals while standing beside its bearer

name: Origami Paper Golem
summary: A thousand pages torn from a forbidden library's books, folded into the shape of a slender man, and animated by the spells written on them. It rustles when it breathes, though it doesn't breathe.
tactics: Bursts into a whirling cloud of razor-edged paper cranes to slice everything in the room, then refolds to wrap survivors up tight.
habitat: libraries, archives, origami masters' studios
weakness: Paper: fire and water both destroy it, and a single torn-out key page holds its animating spell.

powers.name: Paper Cuts
powers.detail: Explodes into a storm of razor-folded pages

alternates.name: Smothering Pages
alternates.detail: Wraps a foe like a mummy in paper

powers.name: Scatter and Refold
powers.detail: Bursts into a flock of paper cranes and refolds elsewhere
